item.title: .NET Fringe 2017 (Lightning Talk)
item.description:
This session will be an lightning-quick dive into getting started with Cake (C# Make) to automate, orchestrate and supercharge your builds.

During the session I will be covering getting started with Cake, from putting together your first build script and understanding Cake’s basics, all the way through every step of the development lifecycle including build, test, packaging, publishing and deployment across any platform.

This session will include simple demos to go from a basic .NET solution to a complete cross-platform automated build solution using a single Cake script.

item.title: User Groups and Meetups

DevOps User Group Gothenburg (DOUGH)

DevSecOps: like DevOps without the annoyed security team (May 12, 2020)

Integrating security controls into DevOps has been the goal, and downfall, of many software teams. While the two pursuits often run counter to each other, there’s plenty of ways to use the tools, processes, and platforms your team is already using to improve the security of your products.

In this talk, we’ll be exploring ways you can integrate and improve security controls in your software at every stage of the DevOps lifecycle. In particular, we’ll be looking for all the ways you can use your existing tools and processes to improve the security of products and platforms without derailing your team’s delivery or giving your security ops team any more sleepless nights than necessary.
